# Volunteer Handbook

Reusable desk procedures for volunteers. This mounted handbook can be read independently of any particular pilot.

- [Check-in checklist](check-in/README.md) — inspect a returned tool and record the handoff.
- [Shift handoff](shifts/README.md) — leave the next volunteer a usable desk state.

The [check-in flow SVG](check-in/check-in-flow.svg) renders offline. A [Mermaid version of the handoff](shifts/README.md#handoff-flow) is in the shift page.
